u = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "performance_http_request" and r._field == "response_time_ms")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) }))
k = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_duration" and r._field == "value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) }))
union(tables: [u, k])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.project =~ /^${project:regex}$/ and r.scenario =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/ and r.testRunID == "${testRunID}" and r.transaction =~ /^${transaction:regex}$/)
  |> group()
  |> count()

u = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "performance_http_request" and r._field == "response_time_ms")
k = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_duration" and r._field == "value")
union(tables: [u, k])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.project =~ /^${project:regex}$/ and r.scenario =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/ and r.testRunID == "${testRunID}" and r.transaction =~ /^${transaction:regex}$/)
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> mean()

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vus" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.project =~ /^${project:regex}$/ and r.scenario =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/ and r.testRunID == "${testRunID}")
  |> group()
  |> max()

u = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "performance_http_request" and r._field == "response_time_ms")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) }))

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_duration" and r._field == "value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) }))
union(tables: [u, k])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.project =~ /^${project:regex}$/ and r.scenario =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/ and r.testRunID == "${testRunID}" and r.transaction =~ /^${transaction:regex}$/)
  |> group()
  |> quantile(q: ${latencyStat}, method: "estimate_tdigest")

u = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "performance_http_request" and r._field == "failed")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._value then 1.0 else 0.0 }))
k = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_failed" and r._field == "value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) }))
union(tables: [u, k])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.project =~ /^${project:regex}$/ and r.scenario =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/ and r.testRunID == "${testRunID}" and r.transaction =~ /^${transaction:regex}$/)
  |> group()
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value * 100.0 }))

latencyU = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "performance_http_request" and r._field == "response_time_ms")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) }))
latencyK = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_duration" and r._field == "value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) }))
latency = union(tables: [latencyU, latencyK])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.project =~ /^${project:regex}$/ and r.scenario =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/ and r.testRunID == "${testRunID}" and r.transaction =~ /^${transaction:regex}$/)
errorsU = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "performance_http_request" and r._field == "failed")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._value then 1.0 else 0.0 }))
errorsK = from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "http_req_failed" and r._field == "value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) }))
errors = union(tables: [errorsU, errorsK])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.project =~ /^${project:regex}$/ and r.scenario =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/ and r.testRunID == "${testRunID}" and r.transaction =~ /^${transaction:regex}$/)
count = latency |> group(columns: ["transaction"]) |> count() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Count", _value: float(v: r._value) }))
minimum = latency |> group(columns: ["transaction"]) |> min() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Min" }))
average = latency |> group(columns: ["transaction"]) |> mean() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Avg" }))
maximum = latency |> group(columns: ["transaction"]) |> max() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Max" }))
p50 = latency |> group(columns: ["transaction"]) |> quantile(q: 0.50, method: "estimate_tdigest") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "p50" }))
p75 = latency |> group(columns: ["transaction"]) |> quantile(q: 0.75, method: "estimate_tdigest") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "p75" }))
p90 = latency |> group(columns: ["transaction"]) |> quantile(q: 0.90, method: "estimate_tdigest") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "p90" }))
p95 = latency |> group(columns: ["transaction"]) |> quantile(q: 0.95, method: "estimate_tdigest") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "p95" }))
p99 = latency |> group(columns: ["transaction"]) |> quantile(q: 0.99, method: "estimate_tdigest") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "p99" }))
errorRate = errors |> group(columns: ["transaction"]) |> mean() |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Error rate %", _value: r._value * 100.0 }))
union(tables: [count, errorRate, minimum, average, maximum, p50, p75, p90, p95, p99])
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["transaction"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> rename(columns: {transaction: "Request"})
  |> keep(columns: ["Request", "Count", "Error rate %", "Min", "Avg", "Max", "p50", "p75", "p90", "p95", "p99"])
  |> sort(columns: ["Count"], desc: true)
